title: Check: Volume of Pyramids and Cones (B)

questions.stem: A pyramid has a volume of $96\text{ cm}^3$ and a rectangular base measuring $6\text{ cm}$ by $8\text{ cm}$. What is its height?
questions.explanation: $V = \frac{1}{3} \times \text{base area} \times h$, so $96 = \frac{1}{3} \times 48 \times h = 16h$. Hence $h = 6\text{ cm}$.
